in_pashto.name: الہلال
in_pashto.meaning: الہلال د چمکې نښه، د میاشتې پیل
in_pashto.long_meaning: الہلال په عربي ژبه کې يو نوم دی چې د چمکې د زياتېدو او يا د میاشتې د پيل معنا لري. دا نوم د اسلامي تقويم په مېنځ کې د يوې مهمې نښې په توګه کارول کيږي، په ځانګړي ډول د رمضان مبارک د میاشتې د پيل نښه ده. دا نوم د اسلامي پېچلې تاريخ او کلتور سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: AlHilal
in_english.meaning: AlHilal means the crescent moon, signifying new beginnings
in_english.long_meaning: AlHilal is an Arabic name derived from the root 'h-l-l', meaning to increase or to rise, referring to the crescent moon. In Islamic tradition, the crescent moon marks the beginning of the lunar month, particularly the holy month of Ramadan. The name AlHilal symbolizes new beginnings, guidance, and divine light. It is often chosen by Muslim parents to reflect their cultural and religious heritage.

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name "AlHilal" holds great cultural significance in the Islamic world, particularly in Arabic-speaking countries. In Islamic astronomical tradition, AlHilal refers to the first crescent moon after the new moon sighting, marking the beginning of the new lunar month and the start of a new Islamic calendar year. The sighting of AlHilal was, and continues to be, an important event in Islamic communities, as it signals the Commencement of the month of Ramadan, which is the Month of Fasting. In many countries, the sighting of AlHilal is celebrated with great enthusiasm and various cultural practices such as special prayers, festivities, and gatherings.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the Islamic name "AlHilal" holds deep significance as a reminder of the constant cycle of life, death, and rebirth. The moon represents the ever-changing cycles of life and serves as a reminder of the transitory nature of existence. The illumination of AlHilal signifies the renewal and revitalization of the spiritual self. It represents a call to turn inward and reflect on one's spiritual growth and development. The sighting of AlHilal is also a reminder of the importance of witnessing and acknowledging the divine signs in nature, and of submitting oneself to the will of Allah. In essence, AlHilal represents a spiritual awakening, a call to renew one's commitment to the divine, and a reminder of the importance of continuous spiritual growth and development.
